faq.q: What does the name Aakil mean?
What is the origin of the name Aakil?
What language does the name Aakil come from?
faq.a: Aakil is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto.

faq.q: Is Aakil a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aakil is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aakil written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aakil is written عاقل in Arabic and عاقل in Urdu, and आक़िल in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aakil?
faq.a: The root of Aakil is ع-ق-ل (ʿ-q-l).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aakil?
faq.a: Arabic ʿāqil, from the root ʿ-q-l, the root of ʿaql (intellect).

faq.q: Does Aakil appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; from the root ʿ-q-l, the root of ʿaql (intellect).
ʿĀqil means 'intelligent, rational, wise' — literally one who possesses ʿaql, the faculty of reason.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aakil?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aakil total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aakil?
faq.a: Aakil appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Aqil, Aakel.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aakil?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aakil include Aakila, Aalim.

faq.q: Is Aakil related to the word ʿaql?
faq.a: Yes. ʿĀqil is the active participle of the root ʿ-q-l, which also yields ʿaql, 'intellect'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aakil used today?
faq.a: Aakil is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
